programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste
programme.desc: Jaspers kæreste fra sommerlejren er kommet for at besøge ham, og hun bor hos Charlotte. Men kæresten bliver jaloux, og tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rytmerne Fortsætter
programme.desc: Da Dr. Minyak vender tilbage, er Henry pludselig i fare, da den ondskabsfulde doktor har lavet hans bedste ven Charlotte om til en super stærk skabning, der skal fange Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del
programme.desc: Henry forsøger at fange Den Gale Bedste - en gammel bedstemor, der bliver ved med at terrorisere Kaptajn Mand i offentligheden. Det giver Henry udfordringer på både arbejds- og kærlighedsfronten.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del
programme.desc: Henrys planer for Frikadelle-festen på Swellview Junior High School er komplicerede, da han bliver nødt til også at møde op som Faredrengen. Under festen sker der ting, der gør, at han må træffe en dramatisk beslutning.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og Sortspætterne
programme.desc: Da Pipers basketballtræner stopper, træder Henry til som træner for Pipers hold i stedet. Han forsøger at piske holdet i form, men møder udfordringer fra idrætskomitéen og deres utraditionelle regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mand: på Ferie
programme.desc: Ray har givet Henry og Charlotte ansvar for Swellview, mens han er bortrejst i forbindelse med sin fætters bryllup. Der opstår problemer, da de skal klare tingene på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Hemmelige Bøf
programme.desc: Henry har fået en invitation til Swellviews mest eksklusive restaurant og beslutter at invitere hans chef, Ray, med. Men tingene blive mere komplicerede end han regnede med.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelige Henry
programme.desc: Efter at Jasper bliver rost som byens helt, bliver Henry jaloux over, at det altid er Faredrengen der får al anerkendelsen, mens han ikke selv får noget som helst.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Julefaren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand må tilbringe julen i fængsel, da han er blevet arresteret for en mindre forbrydelse. Henry og Charlotte må hjælpe ham med at bevare julestemningen bag tremmer.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: En Slem Fjende
programme.desc: Det bliver det rene Romeo og Julie for superhelte, da Phoebe begynder at gå ud med en fyr, som viser sig at være søn af en pensioneret superskurk, der uheldigvis er Thunder Mans ærkefjende.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: De Blå Bønner
programme.desc: Da Max' hud pludselig bliver blå, mens han er ude med en pige, mistænker han alle i familien for at stå bag og optræder som superdetektiv for at finde ud af, hvem den skyldige er.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: En Superhelt Fødes Del 1
programme.desc: Phoebe og Cherrys venskab bliver sat på prøve, da familien Thunderman får en uventet nyhed og må forberede sig på overraskelsen. Max tager med dr. Colosso for at modtage prisen for Årtiets Superskurk.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: En Superhelt Fødes Del 2
programme.desc: Phoebe og Cherrys venskab bliver sat på prøve, da familien Thunderman får en uventet nyhed og må forberede sig på overraskelsen. Max tager med dr. Colosso for at modtage prisen for Årtiets Superskurk.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Kamp Til Stregen
programme.desc: Phoebe melder sig til en tennisturnering for at vinde et medlemskab til Links families country club. Hun får Max til at bruge sine superkræfter til at hjælpe hende, men da han får smag for livet i en country club, vil han selv være medlem.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Sød eller slem
programme.desc: Max og Link skændes, hver gang Link er på besøg, så Phoebe udtænker en plan, der skal få dem til at blive gode venner. Men da Link begynder at være mere sammen med Max end med hende, synes hun, at det er for meget.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Superheltekappen
programme.desc: Phoebe vil koncentrere sig om sin superheltetræning, men da hun sniger sig ud til en fest og redder en fyrs liv, beder hun Max om at tage æren for det, og pludselig er han den store helt.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Straffet
programme.desc: Phoebe opdager, at det er Max, der står bag en masse plakater, der gør grin med rektor. Da hun nægter at afsløre ham for rektor, får hun en hård straf.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Det Store Hit
programme.desc: Da Max bruger personlige informationer om Phoebe og Link til en sangtekst til bandet, bliver han skyld i et brud i deres forhold. I mellemtiden prøver Hank og Barb at lære Billy og Nora noget vigtigt om livet.

programme.title: Familien Thunderman: Ged i Dragen
programme.desc: Phoebe slutter sig til de populære piger, da der skal laves gruppearbejde i skolen, men opdager, at de ikke gider at arbejde så meget som hende. Max slutter sig til Phoebes sædvanlige gruppe og prøver at få dem til at gøre al arbejdet.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 24. december
programme.desc: I 23 dage har Julemand 39 nu efterforsket sandheden om hin juleaften for 19 år siden hos familien Andersen. Sammen med sin assistent, Frits, har han afsløret detalje på detalje, og han troede, at nu havde han fundet sandheden

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 1. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har ikke passet sit job som julemand tilfredsstillende, derfor kræver Julemandsrådet, at han skal gå op til reeksamen.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 2. december
programme.desc: Julemandsrådet har bestemt, at Julemand 39 skal op til julemandseksamen igen. Skæbnen vil, at han får familien Andersen, den vanskeligste opgave

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 3. december
programme.desc: Hvis Julemand 39 ikke kan få familien Andersen til at holde jul, er han ikke længere julemand. Men 39 har en plan

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 4. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 er i overhængende fare for at blive degraderet til nisse. Heldigvis er det lykkedes ham at få anbragt sin assistent, Frits, hos familien Andersen.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 5. december
programme.desc: Frits er vel ankommet til familien Andersens hjem. Han er allerede håbløst forelsket i datteren Putte, men det lykkes ham dog alligevel at finde et vigtigt spor i sagen - en musetrappe, som han tager med tilbage til Julemand 39.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 6. december
programme.desc: For at undgå degradering til nisse, må Julemand 39 få den julefjendske familien Andersen til at fejre jul i år. Hans assistent, Frits, har fundet et spor i sagen - en musetrappe - men han har også forelsket sig stormende i husets datter Putte.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 7. december
programme.desc: Det er en særdeles vanskelig opgave Julemand 39 har fået af Julemandsrådet. Nu ved han ikke en gang, om det et 19 eller 20 år siden, familien sidst holdt jul.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 8. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har kun 17 dage tilbage til at afsløre familien Andersens hemmelighed og få Tage, Åse og Putte til at hengive sig til juleriet. Han har stadig ingen spor at gå efter.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 9. december
programme.desc: Julemandsrådet er ved at miste tålmodigheden med Julemand 39. I endnu et forsøg på at løse gåden om Andersens julefjendskhed har 39 sendt Frits ned til familien forklædt som Åse Andersens lillebror, onkel Klavs fra Australien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 10. december
programme.desc: Den intetanende familien Andersen har taget godt imod Frits, der er forklædt som Åses bror Klavs fra Australien. Familien har det godt - bortset fra Putte, som savner sin gas- og vandmester.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 11. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor har familien Andersen ikke fejret jul i 19 år - eller er det 20? Skal svaret findes i kælderen? Julemand 39’s assistent, Frits, opdager, at Tage Andersen - efter at familien er gået til ro - lister ned i kælderen og låser døren efter sig.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 12. december
programme.desc: Hvor mange hemmeligheder har familien Andersen egentlig? Julemand 39’s opgave bliver vanskeligere og vanskeligere. Moster Karen har hemmeligheder for hele familien.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 13. december
programme.desc: Hvorfor vil familien Andersen ikke fejre jul? Julemand 39 har nu kun 11 dage tilbage til at løse mysteriet, ellers degraderer Julemandsrådet ham til nisse. Julemand 39 har bedt Notarius om at hjælpe sig med at finde Julemand 68

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 14. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har endnu ikke fundet afgørende spor i efterforskningen af familien Andersens julehemmelig­hed. Og der er nogen, der har fjernet vigtige oplys­nin­ger i juleannalerne.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 15. december
programme.desc: Julemand 39 har sporet Julemand 68, den sidste julemand, der har været hos familien Andersen, til Bahamas. Notarius har lovet at skaffe oplysninger , der kan bringe 68 hjem. Putte er ikke den julejomfru

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 16. december
programme.desc: I sine undersøgelser af familien Andersens forsvundne jul, er Julemand 39 kommet på sporet af den førtidspensionerede Julemand 68, som på mystisk vis lever i sus og dus på Bahamas.

programme.title: Andersens Julehemmelighed: 17. december
programme.desc: Nu har Julemand 39 kun en uge til at finde familien Andersens julehemmelighed. Han ved, at Putte smuglæser julekataloger, og han har fundet nye oplysninger i hendes blodprøve.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Marie Macho, Mia Thim og Mads Kolle taler - helt ærligt - om drømmen, gennembruddet og livet som upcoming creators. De deler modgang, ambitioner og deres nomineringer - inden ærligheden bliver sat på prøve i den nervepirrende leg 'Sand eller vand'.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Mads Frandsen og Fishingbrødrene taler - helt ærligt - om at gå all-in på en særlig interesse og gøre niche-content levende for mange. De deler vilde idéer, store drømme og nomineringerne - før vand, eddike og bluffet sætter smagsløgene på prøve.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Malle Riemer og Malika Olsen taler - helt ærligt - om at bruge deres platform til at gøre en forskel, deres nominering og drømme for fremtiden. Til slut bliver alvoren afløst af æggeløbs-konkurrence og en uforudsigelig straf.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: Victor Fog, Mads Dyhr og Håb taler om kemi, venskab og ego i et godt collab. De deler - helt ærligt - erfaringer og tanker om deres nomineringer, før de slås om at få hinanden til at grine og undgå en frygtet straf.

programme.title: Simba: Helt ærligt
programme.desc: MrSpyplant, FredeCS og ViggoMagiccc taler - helt ærligt - om gaming som passion, fællesskab og karriere. De deler deres største øjeblikke, udfordringer og drømme - før en farverig piñatakamp afgør, hvem der skal spinne det farlige strafhjul.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Ellen Hillingsø om skønhed, alder og kunsten at leve livet fuldt ud. Hos Kenny Aleksandr fortæller hun om rynker, røde løbere, beautyfavoritter og sin nye bog – og hvorfor livet kun bliver sjovere, når vi tør være os selv.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Lina Rafn er fyldt 50 og lægger ikke skjul på, at det kræver en indsats at se ud, som hun gør. Med Kenny Aleksandr taler hun om skønhed, alder, vilde X Factor-looks og om at stå ved den, man er – også når man forandrer sig.

programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny bliver slået ihjel af en nedfaldende rumstation og bliver forvandlet til en zombie af noget balsamerende væske, der er forurenet med engelsk sovs.

programme.title: South Park: De bedste venner i verden

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: COPS: Pup and Rescue
programme.desc: A driver denies ownership of what police find in his car. Police conduct a narcotics sting that nets several arrests. A deputy removes a pooch from the scene of an accident.

programme.title: COPS: Undercover Blues
programme.desc: Police work a sting that targets drug dealers. An undercover sting uncovers narcotics trafficking. Police respond to a burglary in progress and discover a flop house.

programme.title: COPS: Multiple Identities
programme.desc: Officers recover a baggie of drugs from a crying suspect. A drunk woman hides a second ID in her back pocket. Police stop a vehicle that hit a patrol car.

programme.title: COPS: Donut Pursuit
programme.desc: Officers pursue a truck after a donut shop robbery. Deputies are dispatched when a wife attacks her husband with an unknown object. Deputies respond to a mother and son knife fight.

programme.title: COPS: Kick the Car
programme.desc: Officers intervene when an estranged husband kicks his ex-wife's boyfriend's car. A man claims someone gave him the car he is driving. A woman claims the pills in her purse are not hers.

programme.title: COPS: Maybe it's Sugar
programme.desc: Police conduct a sting operation. A woman is covered in white powder during a traffic stop. Officers spot a young boy on a bike who wandered away from home.

programme.title: COPS: Not a Momma's Boy
programme.desc: Officers are called to fight between a mother and her son. Officers respond to a man on a trolley hurling racial slurs at a passenger. A traffic stop uncovers narcotics in a young man's trunk.

programme.title: COPS: All Aboard!
programme.desc: Officers pursue a truck driving backwards on a freeway. A suspect jumps a train to evade police. A woman claims to be disabled when a pill falls from her pocket.

programme.title: COPS: To the Lighthouse
programme.desc: Officers are called to a restaurant after the owner was held at gunpoint. Police respond to a woman being sexually harassed in a park. A drunk man tells police he is going to buy a lighthouse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In December 2019, 30-year-old Nadine Lott was brutally beaten by her ex-partner Daniel Murtagh in her Arklow, Ireland apartment. A neighbor witnessed him attacking her "like a wild animal," growling with rage. She died days later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A 16-year-old calls 911 claiming an intruder killed her mom and her mom's boyfriend. But bloody footprints and security footage told a very different story. A true crime case built on lies that unraveled fast.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Florida’s Oldest Missing Child Case That Still Has No Answers: The Puzzling Case of "Jon Jon" Hagans
programme.desc: On June 11, 1968 Jonathan "Jon Jon" Hagans vanished from Jacksonville Beach during a day out in the sun with his loved ones. Authorities wanted to say the waves swept him away but his family never agreed with that theory.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1994, 6-year-old Rikki Neave was strangled by 13-year-old James Watson in Peterborough, England. His mother was wrongly accused. DNA evidence eventually solved the case in 2022, nearly 30 years later.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Canada's Oldest Investigation Solved By Genetic Genealogy
programme.desc: In June 2006, construction workers in Sutherland, Saskatoon, Canada uncovered the remains of an unidentified woman from the early 1900s. Her name and story remained a mystery for another 19 years.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Call
programme.desc: A murder investigation in Florida crosses jurisdictions from New York and Jamaica. The police rely on cell phone mapping, wiretapping and a host of forensic evidence to link a suspect to a murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soft Touch
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pressed for Crime
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta

programme.title: The New Detectives: Witness To Terror

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial Of The Century

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Target

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bodies of Evidence

programme.desc: Illinois serial killer Bruce Lindahl accidentally severed his own femoral artery while stabbing a victim in 1981, dying on the spot. Decades later, DNA forensics posthumously linked him to over 12 murders.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass

programme.title: COPS: Crawling to Vegas
programme.desc: A driver leads police on a slow speed chase towards Las Vegas. Three people are suspected of using contraband. A multi-neighbor dispute devolves into a fight involving guns and bats.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell Case
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains. Taken to hospital, the couple die several days apart. The food poisoning theory is quickly ruled out and forensic tests show the Labrells were poisoned with arsenic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case
programme.desc: In the early hours of the morning, Mathilde Croguennec, 18, attending \"Teknival\" in Brittany, is found at the foot of a tree with her throat cut. Investigators face the task of finding the killer among the 43,000 participants of this festival

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mystery of Room 602 (Ve´ronique Pirotton Case)
programme.desc: On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had found her unconscious in the bathroom with a mysterious plastic bag next to her

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Josiane Bézard Case
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Belize police superintendent is found dead in the water, shot with his own gun. The only witness? A Canadian socialite with ties to one of the country's most powerful families. Her story didn't add up.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: Eleanor Williams claimed she was trafficked and beaten by a grooming gang. Her Facebook post went viral and sparked protests across the UK. But the truth behind her allegations shocked everyone. A case that changed several lives forever.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In October 1983, 15-year-old Tony Muncy's dismembered remains were found in garbage bags along a rural Ohio road. The case went cold for decades until DNA genealogy identified killer Daniel Anderson in 2020.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A man meets a woman on Facebook who says she needs help. Hours later, his throat is slashed and he's thrown off a bridge into a river. Against all odds, he survived. A solved true crime case that is savage, predatory, and an incredible story of survival.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Genetic Genealogy Cracks 53 Year Old Mystery in 2025
programme.desc: June 13, 1972 - The body of a young African American boy was found in a creek in Virginia. His name and story was a mystery until over 5 decades later.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: She sent voice notes to friends saying she feared the worst. Weeks later, a gunman broke into her home looking for her boyfriend and opened fire. A solved true crime case that is devastating, gang-fuelled, and a stark warning about deadly loyalty.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Every Bundy Has A Birthday
programme.desc: When Seven can't remember his birthday, Peggy assigns him one, selecting the next day, which also happens to be Al's birthday. The family decides to go to the town park to celebrate, only to find it's been rented by a rich, snobby family.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Al On The Rocks
programme.desc: When Peggy panics over Seven's sneezes, she begins piling up medical bills, forcing Al to take on a second job as a "topless" bartender.

programme.title: Vore værste år: What I Did For Love
programme.desc: Peg tries everything in the book to renew Al's romantic interest in her -- up to and including promises of five-course meals.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Frat Chance
programme.desc: Desperate for a date, Bud founds his own community college fraternity in his garage.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Chicago Wine Party
programme.desc: With the elections coming up, Al convinces his family to register and vote for the first time in an effort to stop a proposed tax on beer. When the tax increase passes, Al leads an angry protest to overturn the bill.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Kelly Doesn't Live Here Anymore
programme.desc: When Al can't afford to pay the bills, he convinces Kelly to get a job. Finding employment as a waitress at a burger joint, Kelly realizes why mother Peg has never worked a day in her life.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Rock Of Ages
programme.desc: Al meets rock heroes John Sebastian, Peter Noone, Mark Lindsay, Robby Krieger, Richie Havens and Spencer Davis. Mistaking him for a fellow rocker, the musicians convince Al to perform with them at a benefit.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Death Of A Shoe Salesman
programme.desc: While shopping for a burial plot for the family, Al and Peg discover they don't have enough money, so they have to be buried in the same casket.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Old College Try
programme.desc: Bud's big plans to move into his college dorm are destroyed when Al and Peg manage to get their hands on his scholarship money and go on a shopping spree. Broke and dormless, Bud is forced back into the Bundy household.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Christmas
programme.desc: Al does his yearly pre-Christmas inspection of the family and can find they've done nothing wrong, which means he has to buy them presents, but he has to take a job as a Department Store Santa to pay for the gifts.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Drew
programme.desc: I håbet om ENDELIG at overgå sin bror overtaler Chris sine forældre til at lade ham gå til karate. Imens tager Tonye med Rochelle på skønhedsklinik og opdager, hvor sjovt det er at sladre.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader Playboy
programme.desc: Chris finder Julius’ Playboy og tager det med i skole, hvor han tager penge for at vise det frem. Men da Joey stjæler det, skal han skaffe det tilbage, før Julius opdager, at det er væk.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader fængslet
programme.desc: Chris skal skaffe penge til en skoleudflugt ved at sælge småkager. Imens fortryder Julius at have sendt Rochelle til Dreamgirls, mens han passer Tonya og Drew, som har skoldkopper.

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader fars dag

programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Broken Promises
programme.desc: When a popular gym teacher is found dead of what appears to be an accidental gunshot wound, his family is suspicious. A tape recorded by the victim just before his death tells the true story of his strange marriage and his wife's insatiable greed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Expert Witness
programme.desc: In 1993, young mother Tammy Tatum was sexually assaulted and murdered in her Longmont, Colorado apartment. Police initially suspected her estranged husband, but did not have enough evidence to charge him and the case went cold.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fatal Fungus
programme.desc: An infant is rushed to the emergency room with serious breathing problems. Within months, there are more than 30 similar cases. Can doctors find the cause and a cure?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1980's the federal penitentiary in Atlanta held some of the country's most notorious prisoners. Castro called them undesirables. The U.S. government called them detainees. In 1987 they staged a bloody revolt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Coffee Shop Murders
programme.desc: At a coffee shop in Washington, DC, three employees were shot to death. Evidence at the crime scene pointed in many different directions. Was this a hate crime, a robbery gone wrong or an act of cold-blooded vengeance?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: A woman explains why she hired a hitman to kill her fourth husband. Next, an addict watched as a fellow gang member robbed and murdered an unsuspecting man.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode profiles a woman who murdered her own father and stepmother for money. Then, a woman allegedly conspires to murder her husband's ex-wife.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode features a woman who shot her abusive husband and a bipolar woman who killed her 5-year-old stepdaughter after an argument.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode features a woman who murdered her own parents and a woman who helped her husband commit robbery and murder.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode features a woman who was convicted of murdering her millionaire husband and a woman who was an alleged accomplice in the fatal beating of a man held captive in her home.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Shelley Sikes vanishes one night after her shift, and then her abandoned, blood-streaked car is discovered on a dark roadway.

programme.title: On the Case: The Long Path to Justice
programme.desc: A couple's daily walk ends in murder and a cloud of suspicion descends on the victim's family.

programme.title: On the Case: A Father's Quest
programme.desc: After finding his beautiful 19 year old daughter dead, a father launches a relentless pursuit of her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: On the Case: Broken Trust
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes on the way home from school, her family and police are sent on a tormenting search for answers.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Troubling Case Against Kevin Cooper
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: Saving Ethan
programme.desc: FBI agents and analysts take viewers inside a real-life race against the clock to save a 5-year-old boy held hostage by an armed gunman.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: The Spies Next Door
programme.desc: Inside one of the Bureau's most important counterintelligence investigations to track Russian operatives living in America and seeking critical secrets.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: 20 Days of Terror: The Austin Bomber
programme.desc: The Bureau works side by side with multiple law enforcement agencies to identify, track and catch a serial bomber who killed and maimed random victims in Austin in the spring of 2018.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The FBI Declassified: The Swindling Seductress
programme.desc: A career con woman - whose scams included posing as an heir to a cosmetics dynasty and an employee of a top Hollywood filmmaker -- dupes friends, lovers and acquaintances out of hundreds of thousands of dollars.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A pastor's pregnant wife is shot during a home invasion while he's at the gym. Police cleared him fast, but the public wasn't convinced. A solved true crime case full of suspicion, conspiracy theories, and heartbreak.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A beloved teacher is stabbed to death in her own classroom by a 15-year-old student who warned classmates about his plan. No one believed him. A solved true crime case that is shocking, deeply disturbing, and a devastating loss for an entire community.

programme.title: Gabulosis: Weld County Jane Doe: She Waited 51 Years to Be Named
programme.desc: In November of 1973 female skeletal remains were found in a creek in Colorado. Her identity was restored after 51 years but authorities are still asking the public for help piecing together her story.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1991, 19-year-old aspiring actress Heather Stigliano was beaten and stabbed to death in her Myrtle Beach apartment during a robbery. James Whipple was caught weeks later and confessed, saying he killed her for drug money.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle
programme.desc: On July 11, 1963 a fisher in the Keene Creek in Ashland, Oregon reeled in a small bundle. At the center of this bundle was the body of a small boy. A boy who would be unidentified for until 2021.
